info.bio: Less Than Jake América es una banda de ska punk de Gainesville, Florida. Originalmente formado en 1992 como un trío de power pop (Chris Demakes, Shaun Grief y Vinnie Fiorello), la banda evolucionó hasta convertirse en un híbrido de tercera ola ska y punk rock, con adición de elementos de rock moderno e incluso metal. Hasta la fecha, el grupo ha publicado siete  álbumes larga duración y una serie de singles y recopilaciones. La actual agrupación esta compuesta por guitarrista / vocalista Chris Demakes

scenes.name: Hardcore en la era del punk-pop: emocore, ska-core y post-hardcore
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Mientras las revistas anuncian la «muerte del punk», el hardcore se convierte en un movimiento que no deja pueblo sin tocar y genera subgéneros. El «emocore» (Jawbreaker, Weezer, Sunny Day Real Estate, Promise Ring, At The Drive-In, Jimmy Eat World, Seaweed); el hardcore progresivo de Washington (Nation Of Ulysses, Make-Up, Shudder To Think, Jawbox, Edsel, Lungfish, Circus Lupus, Dismemberment Plan); el «ska-core» (Operation Ivy, Rancid, Mighty Mighty Bosstones, Sublime, No Doubt); el punk-pop que llega a las listas (Green Day, Offspring, Flop, Pennywise, Pegboy, Superchunk, Queers); el garage-punk californiano (Drive Like Jehu, Rocket From The Crypt, Blink 182, Zen Guerrilla); el jazzcore (Bazooka, Iceburn); la vieja escuela (D Generation, Supersuckers, Zeke, Dropkick Murphys, Silverfish, Turbonegro) y el post-hardcore de Unwound.
scenes.family: Punk, new wave, hardcore y noise

mentions.author: Piero Scaruffi
mentions.text: …was also pioneered in Boston by Mighty Mighty Bosstones, who penned amusing collections such as Question The Answers (1994). Elsewhere, Wisconsin's Less Than Jake delivered the explosive Pezcore (1994); Kansas' Gadjits the infectious At Ease (1997); New York's Slackers the eclectic Redlight (1997);…

podcast.title: First Warped Tour Set (July 16)
podcast.body: Less Than Jake played their inaugural Warped Tour set on July 16. "On July 16th, the band Less Than Jake played their first Warped set."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Record for Most Warped Tour Sets
podcast.body: Less Than Jake holds the record for performing the most sets on the Warped Tour, with an estimated number exceeding 400 performances, though the exact figure is uncertain. "They hold the record for the most warped sets ever. No one is quite sure of the exact number, but it's somewhere north of 400."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Warped Tour Feature
xref.body: Goldfinger was one of the bands featured during the initial years of the Warped Tour, a key platform for pop punk and ska punk music. "In just the first few years, the tour featured bad religion, dancehall crashes, face to face, bucket nine, less than Jake, muddy, muddy boss tones, no doubt, sublime, and gold finger."
